The core was a 15 m Meshy crystal cluster at the foot of the heart cleft (heart_cleft, angle 90 deg, r 51 m), small and boxed behind the deck slab. A Blender heart cradle (assets/props/blender-1107/stormheart_heart_cradle, script in ralph/reports/LANES/ITEM-F41-1/build_heart_cradle.py) replaces it there: a 16 m faceted crystal core with ten smaller prisms (natural lightning glow), lodged at 17-31 m in a sling of five crossing roots and held open toward the hollow by nine braided heartwood roots that rise from the floor and climb the cleft to 46 m, three with vein lines. The core sits above the 6-16 m band the deck slab hides from the hollow stands (first capture, unjudged: at 1-16 m only its glow showed under the slab, as a flat white blob). Everything stays at r >= 45.6 m, outside the 44 m hollow floor. The Meshy CrystalHeart is hidden while this is on. No collider, floor or route change. OFF until judged.
